description: Traders’ Academy provides a deep pool of financial trading and analytics courses, filled with a slew of economics-related information, including about key economic reports, macroeconomics, microeconomics, as well as domestic and global economic indicators, such as from the European Union (EU), the United Kingdom (UK), and Canada. Other concepts concerning fundamental analyses are explored, including how to analyze corporate balance sheets, cash flow statements, income statements, as well as use certain YMC tools available through its award-winning Trader Workstation platform, such as the YMC Fundamental Explorer, and YMC’s IMPACT app. Traders and investors can also learn about technical analyses, building a financial trading plan, environmental, social, and governance (ESG) investing strategies, as well as other investment opportunities centered on cryptocurrencies and derivatives (e.g., Bitcoin, Bitcoin Futures, Options on Micro Bitcoin and Micro Ether Futures).
name: Fundamentals
